candidates.hypothesis: Layered manifests may improve defect localization and scope reporting beyond a standard spreadsheet audit under equal operations, without misclassifying legitimate weighting variants as bugs or matching corrected aggregates as causal identification.
candidates.experiment: Generate 24 independent parent workbooks with 30 country histories and unequal 10–40-year observations. Create four blinded variants per parent: clean, one injected range/inclusion defect, interacting defects and an explicitly declared valid weighting variant. Shuffle labels and hide mutation maps and numerical expected values; give both auditors the same raw synthetic country-year data, formulas, declared aggregation specification and hashes. Publish hidden-score commitments before auditing and reveal reference outputs only afterward. Freeze 20 operations per workbook from the same menu: range-boundary scan, raw-to-cell reconciliation, inclusion-list comparison, weight-sum check, manual recomputation and scope-statement check. Both auditors use identical executed checks; compare a standard formula-audit report with scope notes against a layer-organized report. All variants of a parent remain in one train/test split. Estimate differences and intervals over independent parent workbooks, never treating 96 variants or country-years as independent audit replications.
candidates.baseline: A conventional spreadsheet-audit checklist with formula review, data reconciliation, explicit estimand and causal-scope notes. Same files, specifications, 20 checks and report fields: implemented output, spec-compliant output, suspected cell/rule defects, valid alternative estimand, and causal-scope verdict. No forced binary badge or denied localization opportunity.
candidates.metric: Report separately: exact defect-set recovery and cell/rule precision/recall; implemented-output and spec-compliant-output absolute errors against hidden references; false bug labels on declared valid variants; and unsupported causal-validation statements / all reports. Set numerical tolerance at 1e-10 × max(1, absolute reference), publish rounding rules, and retain unresolved defect labels. Cluster every metric by parent workbook.
candidates.falsifier: If the standard audit matches localization and numerical reconstruction with equal checks, layering has no demonstrated advantage. If layered reporting labels legitimate variants as bugs or treats matched numbers as causal confirmation, its mechanism fails. Defect recovery cannot establish the real debt-growth causal threshold.
candidates.confound: Injected mutations may be cleaner than undocumented historical revisions; source-country definitions and hidden missingness can remain unresolved. Equal-country and equal-observation weighting are different estimands unless one contradicts the declared specification; neither is inherently a coding error. The author response and critical reconstruction remain attached without manufacturing a winner.
candidates.feasibility: Proposed deterministic synthetic workbook generator and report renderer; no original workbooks, historical-data rerun or policy inference has been executed.
candidates.changes: Replaced the checksum badge with a strong formula-and-scope baseline and identical report fields/checks. Hid scoring references and mutation labels, added interacting mutations plus valid weighting alternatives, separated implemented versus specification-compliant outputs, fixed numerical tolerances, and clustered clones by source workbook.

candidates.title: Preserve unresolved selection explanations in wage reporting matrices

sources.locator: Original establishment survey https://www.nber.org/papers/w4509; payroll-based comment https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/aer.90.5.1362; reply with administrative analysis https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/aer.90.5.1397
sources.use: Compare respondent, payroll-available and administrative-covered establishment frames with common and frame-specific estimands.
sources.boundary: The comment and reply are rival measurement/coverage checks, not an assumed winner; the episode remains context-specific.

sources.locator: Original multiple outcomes https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20855902/; larger replication https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25810452/; broader preregistered synthesis https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000356
sources.use: Transfer outcome-family declaration and reporting of all endpoints to distinguish outcome cherry-picking from sample attrition.
sources.boundary: Physiological and subjective posture outcomes are not wage outcomes; this transfers selection-accounting methods, not conclusions about either paper.

candidates.mechanism: A frame-by-endpoint matrix can expose observable sample and outcome differences without uniquely identifying why they occurred. Comparing it with an equally complete narrative tests reporting discipline. Explicit unresolved classes prevent sample selection, effect heterogeneity and latent nonresponse from being forced into a single explanation.
candidates.hypothesis: With identical results and permissible labels, a structured matrix may reduce false attribution and false reconciliation relative to a complete narrative. It must preserve unresolved observationally equivalent mixtures, not gain credit merely for printing more labels.
candidates.experiment: Generate 72 independent synthetic policy episodes, each with 200 initial establishments and pre/post measurements of headcount, paid hours and open status. Closure means zero population headcount/hours and open=0; nonresponse is missing, not closure. Define frames as survey-responding, payroll-available and administrative-covered; each frame is fixed by pre-policy membership where observable. Frame-specific descriptive contrasts target that fixed cohort including observed closures; full initial-population contrasts are separate truth values, not assumed identifiable from responding frames. Freeze nine analyses: 3 frames × 3 endpoints. Include isolated observed-selection, endpoint-definition and size-heterogeneity worlds plus mixed latent-manager-shock worlds. Construct paired latent worlds with identical released observations/masks but different unobserved nonrespondent outcomes, so population attribution is genuinely unresolved. Both reporting algorithms receive all nine estimates, definitions and masks; freeze training-tuned rules before holding out complete episode families. Use 2,000 whole-episode bootstrap draws for aggregate report-error rates. Within-episode joint intervals for nine frame contrasts use prespecified cluster max-t simulation calibrated on independent episode-family draws; report failures under global shocks separately, not as guaranteed nominal coverage.
candidates.baseline: A fully reported narrative with all nine estimates, intervals, endpoint/frame dictionary and missingness information, identical length budget and labels. Both may label observable frame sensitivity, observable endpoint sensitivity, unresolved/mixture or no detected disagreement; latent causal-source labels require identification. Both can preserve disagreement and abstain. Matrix layout alone earns no score.
candidates.metric: Freeze attribution rules: flag frame sensitivity only for different-frame contrasts with matched endpoints; endpoint sensitivity only for different endpoints within a fixed frame; neither flag is a causal explanation. If two latent worlds yield identical released data but disagree on the population contrast/source, the required label is unresolved/mixture. Measure false definitive attribution / unresolved fixtures, missed observable sensitivities, and false reconciliation / truly conflicting aligned contrasts. Report familywise 95% coverage for nine frame-specific contrasts and separately coverage/abstention for population contrasts; no pooling of their denominators.
candidates.falsifier: If structured reporting assigns a unique source in observationally equivalent mixtures, it fails. Persistent within-frame, within-endpoint disagreement counts against sample/endpoint mismatch alone. If the complete narrative preserves disagreement and calibration equally well, the matrix has no demonstrated advantage. Apparent source attribution without identification is not success.
candidates.confound: Unobserved manager shocks and employer anticipation can jointly drive response and employment, leaving full-population effects unidentified. Fixed pre-policy frames differ from observed post-policy availability; missing membership must be flagged unresolved. Shared episode shocks can invalidate within-episode interval calibration. Neither workflow settles a universal wage law or ranks the comment and reply as winners.
candidates.feasibility: Proposed offline generator, fixed nine-analysis table and two deterministic report algorithms; no original-data reanalysis, real causal effect estimate or policy advice has been executed.
candidates.changes: Added a fully reported baseline with equal labels, results and output budget. Defined closure/nonresponse, fixed frames, frame-specific versus population estimands, observable sensitivity rules and a mandatory unresolved class for exact observational equivalence. Specified joint-interval calibration, independent episode-family sampling and separate denominators for attribution and coverage.

evaluations.feedback: Endpoint separation and unavailable-build caveats respect both dossiers. The fluency-versus-executable agreement comparison is underspecified: agreement with what, on which scale, and how is correctness leakage prevented? The deterministic test baseline is feasible, but a 0.10 cutoff lacks justification.
evaluations.revision: Define agreement as preregistered discrimination against separate held-out solution labels; specify fluency raters, reliability checks and a justified minimum effect. Keep disagreement descriptive and avoid equating it with absent understanding.

evaluations.feedback: The transfer concerns aggregation rather than economic effects, and keeps ethical conclusions separate. Four denominators are promised but not completely enumerated. Rank reversals can follow arithmetic and task mix mechanically; this alone would establish neither broad efficiency nor conceptual novelty.
evaluations.revision: Name all four denominators and their intended decision questions; preregister hardware/time normalization and zero-success handling. Contrast observed reversals with analytically predicted reversals and report uncertainty for near ties.

evaluations.feedback: The randomized fictional-rule contrast is appropriately narrower than the wage natural experiment or general intelligence. Mechanism and controls are credible. Probability shifts, answer changes and difference-in-differences are not yet one clearly defined estimand, and the 0.60 target may be ceiling-limited.
evaluations.revision: Specify binary rule-consistency scoring and a paired randomized-intervention estimand; distinguish updating from factual accuracy. Set attainable effect thresholds using a separately generated pilot and freeze all fictional vocabulary before confirmation.

evaluations.feedback: The proposal fairly separates Parrots interpretations from ethics and posture endpoints. Identical outputs provide an unusually clean framing intervention. The understanding rubric nevertheless invites contested semantics; correctness-judgment changes and interpretive-rating changes need distinct hypotheses rather than a single susceptibility verdict.
evaluations.revision: Publish exact symmetric label templates and operational rating anchors. Analyze correctness-label error separately from understanding attribution, with equivalence bounds and multiplicity handling; avoid interpreting a judge framing effect as a human or ontology result.

evaluations.feedback: Version and paradigm boundaries are faithfully preserved, and task-family uncertainty is appropriate. A fixed-seed rerun may be deterministic by construction, making repeatability trivial. The comparison between reruns and new templates also changes presentation without clearly defining matched accuracy differences.
evaluations.revision: Separate computational determinism from behavioral robustness; add controlled stochastic decoding or repeated environments where relevant. Define paired template contrasts on the same latent problems and preregister equivalence margins with information-preserving template validation.

evaluations.feedback: The source transfer protects normative and endpoint distinctions, with no whole-paper truth claim. Mechanistic improvement may come from putting the answer taxonomy into one prompt rather than from replication bookkeeping. Synthetic author keys and ledger vocabulary could make the result circular.
evaluations.revision: Use independently authored ambiguous packets, blind the answer-key construction to prompts, and add an equally explicit untyped instruction baseline. Evaluate evidence-link entailment with adjudicated uncertainty rather than compulsory philosophical classifications.

evaluations.feedback: Selection and weighting are methodological transfers with historical allegations explicitly excluded. A known task population gives a useful benchmark. Deliberately curating easy examples practically guarantees inflation; uncertainty from a fixed output pool cannot cover new model generations or family universes.
evaluations.revision: Vary curator strength including random selection and report when balancing fails under within-family selection. Define the population estimand and separate resampling uncertainty from generation and task-family sampling uncertainty; include balanced but contaminated showcases.

evaluations.feedback: The firewall appropriately treats exploration as useful and avoids attributing undisclosed search to authors. However, the stated reusable response matrix, extra confirmation families and matched realized token costs are not mutually specified. Repeated splits can leak confirmation through protocol development.
evaluations.revision: Fix the complete query matrix and cost accounting before generation; reserve one untouched final split outside the 30 resamples. Compare search as a deployable system, reporting both fixed-query and realized-token budget analyses.

evaluations.feedback: Endpoint distinctions and related-versus-direct challenge status are precise. Comparing against a simple endpoint table is valuable. The parser implementation and assertive-output generation remain unclear; a deterministic pipeline can win because the injected errors are exactly those its type rules forbid.
evaluations.revision: Specify both executable parsers and a blinded held-out summary generator. Include measurement noninvariance within endpoints and ambiguous labels; score abstention and false rejection, with thresholds fixed before synthetic world identities are disclosed.

evaluations.feedback: The ledger fairly distinguishes recall-specific studies, broader paradigms and alternate employment measurements. Duplicate reports genuinely threaten uncertainty. But sample-and-paradigm deduplication can still count multiple correlated outcomes as independent, and the fixed estimator does not yet define dependence handling.
evaluations.revision: Specify a sample-level multivariate or cluster-robust estimator and explicit overlap graph. Include partially overlapping participants across paradigms, imperfect overlap metadata and duplicate-independent reports; score uncertainty calibration without treating deduplication itself as sufficient.

evaluations.feedback: Temporal contracts transfer as software safeguards without pretending failed recall tests cover all Bem endpoints. Positive-control language avoids endorsing retrocausation. Event-stream generation and artifact classification still need operational definitions; ordinary resampling is a weak comparator for systematic indexing defects.
evaluations.revision: Add standard timestamp validation and permutation/placebo baselines at matched implementation effort. Publish exact leakage mechanisms, blinded artifact families and separate false scientific-effect flags from software-integrity warnings; keep signal detectability distinct from artifact localization.

evaluations.feedback: The randomized-versus-observational distinction is explicit, and total effects are separated from pathways. The synthetic examples are feasible and fair. Given random assignment, an unadjusted contrast already identifies the total effect; the checker may only prevent an intentionally bad adjustment baseline.
evaluations.revision: Add baseline-covariate precision adjustment and blinded role metadata, alongside the unadjusted gold-standard baseline. Evaluate whether the checker recognizes unidentified mediation and wrong graphs, measuring extra information or error prevention beyond ordinary randomized-trial practice.

evaluations.feedback: Both source scopes and missing implementation information are treated carefully. A locked rule classifier is necessarily invariant to outcome labels when it never receives them; comparison with a result-aware baseline therefore risks proving an input restriction rather than better replication judgment.
evaluations.revision: Give all workflows identical protocol inputs and optional blinded outcome fields, then score using independently adjudicated equivalence cases and alternative rubrics. Include justified same-endpoint procedural deviations and report unresolved cases rather than forcing direct labels.

evaluations.feedback: Crossing instruments and contexts is a defensible method transfer, with endpoint scales explicitly kept separate. The design has only 12 sites and complex dependence; two mappings of one synthetic record do not supply independent instrument validation. Classification chance and power are unspecified.
evaluations.revision: Define the hierarchical generative model, identifiability assumptions and classification rule; set chance and abstention baselines. Include instrument-by-context interactions and independent instrument noise, checking site-level interval coverage and feasibility before claiming moderator localization.

evaluations.feedback: The proposal preserves paradigm distinctions and openly recognizes invisible missing studies. A sensitivity grid tests robustness but generally cannot identify whether weighting or unobserved selection generated the data. Recovery of a planted source risks using simulator-specific signatures unavailable in actual literature.
evaluations.revision: Define an explicit observable-only classifier with an unresolved category and test observationally equivalent selection worlds. Report coverage by paradigm and missingness assumptions; describe the grid as sensitivity mapping unless identification is demonstrated on held-out generators.

evaluations.feedback: The method transfer avoids accusing either original of selective reporting and preserves endpoint identity. Budget-matched multiplicity correction is a strong comparator. Discovery-only and split-sample procedures currently conflate selection rules with unequal estimation precision, and confirmation criteria are not operationally stated.
evaluations.revision: Specify exact tests, multiplicity procedures and selected-effect estimators, with sample-size-matched secondary comparisons. Lock endpoint-specific confirmation and shared-batch generators before search; report conditional power and inflation without claiming that an administrative firewall creates independence.

evaluations.feedback: The endpoint ledger represents comment and reply fairly and does not turn a local wage estimate into a universal law. Synthetic endpoint truth makes testing feasible. The deliberately common employment label is weak; ordinary unit checking may provide most of the benefit.
evaluations.revision: Add a strong baseline using explicit units and sample-frame notes without a ledger. Define contradictory effects only for aligned estimands and report mismatched endpoints as incomparable; predeclare closure handling and episode-level interval construction.

evaluations.feedback: The proposal distinguishes descriptive debt summaries from causal thresholds and labels the AI metric challenge as related. Yet neighboring-bin differences do not inherently declare discontinuities. Nominally matching false-positive budgets needs a shared threshold null; otherwise the central comparison is apples to oranges.
evaluations.revision: Define a discontinuity estimand and calibrated tests with the same null and error rate; retain bin contrasts as descriptive unless explicitly tested. Specify country-held-out selection and block dependence before contrasting smooth and genuine-break worlds.

evaluations.feedback: The temporal analogy is explicitly methodological, and passing placebos is not claimed to prove causality. Allowing abstention improves fairness. However, observationally equivalent worlds cannot be direction-classified reliably; neither the classifier nor the graph-plus-placebo rule is executable yet.
evaluations.revision: Publish the observable inputs, decision rules and common abstention loss. Add exactly observationally equivalent worlds, mixed bidirectional effects and persistent shocks; report underidentification as success rather than penalizing correct refusal to infer causal direction.

evaluations.feedback: The claim ledger preserves both the wage dispute and Parrots normative distinction. Episode-level assessment avoids establishment pseudoreplication. A latent shock may be undetectable in observed panels, so scoring correct causal labels against hidden world labels can reward impossible oracle behavior.
evaluations.revision: Define which violations are diagnostically observable and construct indistinguishable valid/confounded worlds. Equalize both workflows information and abstention loss; score calibrated identification sets or acknowledged uncertainty, and keep policy values entirely outside empirical correctness ratings.

evaluations.feedback: Replication layers faithfully distinguish documented spreadsheet defects, valid weighting alternatives and causal claims; the author response is retained. Mutation testing is practical. A single checksum badge is an undemanding comparator, while expected outputs may disclose the injected defect too directly.
evaluations.revision: Use a standard spreadsheet-audit baseline with explicit scope notes and equal checks. Hide clone labels, include interacting mutations and valid alternative estimands, and score localization separately from output matching and unsupported causal-validation language.

evaluations.feedback: Version locking is transferred without importing AI or wage effect sizes, and measurement versus transport distinctions are fair. The four-class scoring assumes a dataset difference has one cause; real vintage changes can combine population and measurement changes, as already acknowledged.
evaluations.revision: Include mixed-cause and genuinely unresolved cases with multlabel or abstention scoring. Add a strong flat report with free-text scope explanation, retain exact code-failure tests, and score universal extrapolation separately from reconstruction category labels.

evaluations.feedback: Country histories are not equated with independent psychology experiments, and selection sensitivity is not called causal identification. The mechanism is defensible. Contribution bounds require specified growth support and missingness assumptions; without these, full-panel interval coverage and reversal detection may be infeasible.
evaluations.revision: State growth support, observed-selection assumptions and bound construction before simulation. Include indistinguishable latent-selection worlds, score justified unresolved conclusions, and separate descriptive contribution attribution from claims to recover missing full-history associations.

evaluations.feedback: The frame-by-endpoint matrix preserves rival evidence and does not presume equal support or a winner. Its transfer is methodological and testable. Attribution among selection, heterogeneity and latent manager shocks can remain unidentified despite a complete matrix; multiplicity coverage needs a defined procedure.
evaluations.revision: Specify observed-data attribution rules, simultaneous interval method and a mixture/unresolved class. Add indistinguishable causal worlds and a strong fully reported baseline; distinguish establishment closure from nonresponse throughout the synthetic estimand dictionary.

evaluations.feedback: The four denominators now identify distinct decision questions, preserve Parrots ethical scope, and avoid transferring a debt effect. Nonfinite ratios and unresolved rankings are operationally acknowledged. Remaining feasibility issues concern paired timing dependence and whether overhead amortization dominates the claimed denominator reversal.
evaluations.revision: Specify the nested resampling algorithm and interval construction for nonfinite family ratios. Report fixed-batch overhead sensitivity independently of reweighting sensitivity, retaining accuracy/time frontiers when scalar rankings disagree.

evaluations.feedback: The intervention estimand is now explicit and the sources retain their limited scope. Component reporting and baseline accuracy constrain misleading update claims. However, subtracting companion degradation can enlarge the contrast; the stable-companion condition needs an actual equivalence criterion rather than a verbal proviso.
evaluations.revision: Lock a companion noninferiority margin and multiplicity-adjusted joint decision rule before confirmation. Explain why the pilot-derived threshold represents useful evidence use; preserve unresolved labels when targeted updating coexists with substantial unrelated disruption.

evaluations.feedback: The revision cleanly separates deterministic reruns from stochastic template robustness, with simultaneous contrasts and explicit equivalence margins. Its narrow outcome no longer credits passport bookkeeping with causal improvement. Eighty problems may yield inconclusive equivalence intervals, which the proposal appropriately treats as unresolved.
evaluations.revision: Specify the simultaneous interval algorithm and prospectively simulate interval width across correlated seed outcomes. Keep latent-problem generation and template validation separate from confirmation scoring; report whether the desired equivalence precision was attainable.

evaluations.feedback: Selection mechanisms now include random and within-family-biased conditions, and uncertainty is limited to declared families. The source transfer remains fair. A sealed reference set estimates a separate finite-population mean, so discrepancies can combine showcase bias with reference sampling error rather than isolate selection.
evaluations.revision: Define target correctness over a common enumerated population or explicitly decompose reference-sampling error from selection bias. Publish softmax sampling formulas, weighting estimators and missing-support rules before observing confirmation outputs.

evaluations.feedback: Global dependence clustering and conditional missing-overlap envelopes repair major uncertainty omissions while preserving paradigm scope. The proposed union of intervals is explicitly conditional, which is appropriate. Equal base-sample weighting still needs a precise rule when partial participant overlap prevents a unique base-sample decomposition.
evaluations.revision: Define estimable endpoint targets and weights using only released summaries and overlap metadata. Include ambiguous decompositions, show resulting identification sets or abstention, and specify component-bootstrap validity checks beyond a fixed minimum cluster count.

evaluations.feedback: The structural equations, cached fits and ordinary precision-adjustment comparator make this a bounded executable audit. Random assignment identifies total effects while pathway claims remain unresolved. Declared timing information can still be wrong; the checker cannot verify graph roles from the observed table alone.
evaluations.revision: Define exactly what counts as verified pre-assignment metadata and predeclare how erroneous metadata enters the checker. Retain estimation and interpretation outcomes separately; demonstrate any added value over ordinary baseline-adjusted randomized-trial practice.

evaluations.feedback: Independent crossed measurements and relative component estimands repair the previous paired-recoding problem. Source boundaries remain careful, and weak information permits abstention. Eight training sites constrain random-slope coverage; the stated fitted model omits the interaction stress term without defining how interaction-driven nonidentifiability is detected.
evaluations.revision: Specify the instrument-by-site interaction diagnostic and complete both/neither/unresolved decision table. Prospectively calibrate bootstrap coverage and localization with eight sites, reporting insufficient information rather than treating simulation truth as observable component evidence.

evaluations.feedback: Selection, confirmation, multiplicity and estimators are now operational and comparable to full-data Holm. The text preserves endpoint-specific scope and avoids historical allegations. Shared-batch stress correctly exposes independence assumptions. Joint dependence among the thirty synthetic contrasts and record-level construction still require a concrete generator.
evaluations.revision: Publish joint contrast covariance and record-generation equations, including the prelocked shared-batch regime. Report conditional effect inflation separately for selection and confirmation, retaining the sample-size-matched comparison and endpoint-wise uncertainty.

evaluations.feedback: The strong units-and-frame comparator, closure handling and descriptive truth target substantially improve fairness. The wage reply and posture endpoint distinctions remain attached without forced reconciliation. Ten regimes can give unstable bootstrap uncertainty, and exact automated compatibility-label rules are still required.
evaluations.revision: Publish both report procedures as deterministic rules on the same fields, including equivalence tolerances and unknown metadata. Calibrate across independent regime draws, separating numerical estimation coverage from compatibility-classification performance.

evaluations.feedback: The revised audit operationalizes retained-family abstention and explicitly penalizes directional claims on indistinguishable fixtures. It transfers temporal safeguards without implying retrocausality. Candidate models containing latent persistent shocks need identifiable fitting and rejection procedures; their names alone do not make observational compatibility testable.
evaluations.revision: Specify fitted latent-model likelihoods, parameter bounds and exact rejection diagnostics before generation. Prove identical observables for equivalence fixtures and report conditional model-set coverage; retain unresolved verdicts when latent families cannot be distinguished or fitted reliably.

evaluations.feedback: Hidden mutation maps, strong audits and valid alternative estimands preserve the historical reconstruction dispute unusually precisely. Parent-workbook clustering avoids clone pseudoreplication. With identical executed checks and report fields, however, the additional mechanism may be report organization alone; the transformation producing different decisions needs definition.
evaluations.revision: Implement both report renderers and decision policies before testing, specifying how layer structure can alter localization or scope assertions with identical check results. Treat equal performance as evidence against added utility, not an underpowered success.

evaluations.feedback: Observable sensitivity flags are now explicitly distinguished from causal source attribution, and indistinguishable latent worlds mandate unresolved conclusions. The source transfer remains appropriately narrow. Frame membership and missing outcomes can obstruct even frame-specific descriptive contrasts; joint interval calibration is named but not yet executable.
evaluations.revision: Specify contrast estimators and missing-data assumptions for each fixed frame, refusing intervals where its target remains unidentified. Publish joint max-t generation and complete reporting rules; validate frame-specific and population coverage separately under latent nonresponse.

evaluations.feedback: Family-level sampling and separate endpoints are appropriate. However, agreement is undefined across a fluency rubric, binary correctness and transfer scores; the composite also lacks an external decision target. A numerical gap could reflect incompatible scales rather than dissociated competencies.
evaluations.revision: Define and preregister a common agreement statistic, calibration set and rubric reliability threshold. Test separate-endpoint versus composite prediction of an untouched transfer outcome, with family-clustered uncertainty and difficulty-stratified results.

evaluations.feedback: The denominator audit preserves the resource-versus-values boundary and matches tasks and hardware. Four denominators are promised but not all operationally specified. Ratio instability when verified successes approach zero, and one attempt per task, can dominate apparent model ranking reversals.
evaluations.revision: List all four numerator/denominator formulas, include warm-up and search costs, define zero-success handling, and reserve repeated paired measurement runs. Bootstrap paired families and measurement repetitions; treat unstable rank intervals as inconclusive.

evaluations.feedback: Randomized fictional rules, unaffected questions and matched edit placebos discriminate targeted evidence use from generic disruption. The answer-probability estimand needs clarification because deterministic exact outputs and repeated stochastic samples imply different denominators. The 0.60 cutoff currently lacks precision planning.
evaluations.revision: Define probability as correct-family frequency or prespecified repeated decoding frequency, publish the paired contrast formula, and simulate power around 0.60. Keep seeds and symbolic generators sealed until prompts and scoring lock.

evaluations.feedback: Identical artifact bytes provide a strong within-output intervention, and objective correctness remains separate from attributed understanding. Neutral repetition is mentioned but absent from the 300-judgment budget. Artifact construction and label-specific refusal can otherwise masquerade as framing sensitivity.
evaluations.revision: Budget neutral repetitions explicitly; freeze artifact-generation and correctness-stratification rules before labeling. Specify missing/refusal handling, paired effect estimation and rubric anchors, and retain interpretation-only conclusions about this particular automated judge.

evaluations.feedback: Version hashes and family-level uncertainty make the rerun/transfer distinction executable. A three-template design can estimate presentation sensitivity, but the passport itself is not experimentally compared. Fixed seeds also need a hardware/kernel reproducibility policy before exact-output failures imply anything substantive.
evaluations.revision: Choose whether the outcome tests template robustness or passport bookkeeping. For the former, preregister template-equivalence checks, decoding determinism and runtime hashes; estimate transfer gaps without interpreting unavailable historical-model replication.

evaluations.feedback: Constructed scope keys avoid scoring philosophical agreement, and omission accounting prevents an abstain-on-everything victory. Repeated runs and paraphrases are dependent, while author-written keys can favor the typed vocabulary. Ninety packets may be fewer independent families than the nominal count implies.
evaluations.revision: Define packet-family independence and use family-clustered paired intervals. Freeze an unseen paraphrase generator, distinguish wrong links from legitimate unknowns, and compare against a simple structured endpoint table at equal token cost.

evaluations.feedback: The complete pool and sealed holdout permit a transparent selection demonstration without alleging historical cherry-picking. Deliberately choosing easier families almost builds inflation into the design. One thousand resamples provide conditional sampling precision, not one thousand independent evaluations of the model or generator.
evaluations.revision: Vary selection strength from random to strongly curated, preregister a known population target, and report conditional versus generator-level uncertainty separately. Include a held-out family generator to test whether balancing actually transports.

evaluations.feedback: Including prompt-search cost and a fixed-prompt comparator is a useful selection audit. Reusing one response matrix across thirty splits risks treating overlapping confirmation families as independent. Equal total response-token cost, equal query opportunities and the stated 2,000-generation ceiling are not yet reconciled.
evaluations.revision: Publish a single budget ledger covering matrix generation, selection and confirmation. Hold out an untouched final family set, report overlap-aware uncertainty, and compare both equal-cost deployed systems and equal-size confirmation subsets.

evaluations.feedback: Endpoint-preserving controls and the simple stratified-table comparator prevent unnecessary complexity from winning automatically. The synthetic construction is feasible, but unsupported assertions and same-endpoint recovery need executable definitions. Repeated recodings of one summary cannot enlarge the independent sample count.
evaluations.revision: Specify assertion grammar, unknown handling and exact recovery criteria before generator release. Reserve unseen wording families, cluster all recoding variants within summaries, and report whether richer typing beats the endpoint-table baseline.

evaluations.feedback: Known overlap, independent-sample controls and coverage across seeded corpora directly test pseudoreplication. Deduplicating sample-and-paradigm identifiers alone may still double-count samples participating in multiple paradigms. Unknown overlap cannot yield a uniquely correct effective sample size without explicit dependence assumptions.
evaluations.revision: Make sample identity global across paradigms, simulate cross-paradigm dependence, and specify the covariance-aware pooling estimator. Score exact-overlap recovery separately from honest bounds under unknown overlap; publish interval construction and Monte Carlo uncertainty.

evaluations.feedback: The proposal confines conclusions to software timing and preserves the recall-specific boundary. However, a physically ordered null log and a clean injected retroactive association require separately defined generators. Ordinary resamples are not necessarily comparable computational units to validation rules and placebo contrasts.
evaluations.revision: Define injected association as a deliberately noncausal software fixture, freeze leakage-blind validation rules, and calibrate thresholds on separate seeds. Report operation counts and wall time alongside matched contrast counts and held-out artifact-family sensitivity.

evaluations.feedback: Known total effects, randomized assignment, explicit collider scenarios and an unadjusted baseline form a strong bounded simulator. Wrong-graph evaluation appropriately challenges oracle information. The proposed three-model budget needs a precise treatment of which covariates the checker can observe or reject.
evaluations.revision: Publish all four structural equations and approved adjustment rules before sampling; distinguish graph knowledge from data access. Evaluate oracle, wrong and unknown graphs separately, retaining endpoint-specific coverage and the unadjusted total-effect baseline.

evaluations.feedback: Scope distinctions and unknown fields are carefully preserved, but a deterministic classifier forbidden to see outcome labels is invariant by construction. Comparing it with a result-aware baseline cannot establish reduced post-hoc exemption; rubric agreement may merely test faithful implementation of the same rubric.
evaluations.revision: Give comparable classifiers identical protocol information and randomized outcome-label access in a factorial design. Score held-out scope errors against independently specified alternate rubrics, and label deterministic invariance as a software property, not behavioral evidence.

evaluations.feedback: Crossing measurement with context can identify components that confounded allocations cannot. Separate endpoint channels and interaction stress tests preserve scientific scope. Twelve sites limit site-level generalization, and duplicate mappings of one participant must not be counted as independent measurement information.
evaluations.revision: Specify allocation and hierarchical estimator equations, reserve whole sites before method tuning, and calibrate uncertainty with site-level resampling. Report failures under instrument-by-context interaction and compare harmonization at matched genuinely independent measurements.

evaluations.feedback: Stratum-specific reporting and hidden-missingness scenarios correctly separate visible robustness from validity. Nevertheless, a visible multiverse cannot generally identify whether absent null studies or outcome selection caused the same record distribution. A localization score without an abstention category could reward unjustified certainty.
evaluations.revision: Construct observationally equivalent selection worlds and permit an unresolved-source verdict under a prespecified loss. Freeze all 27 specifications, hold out mechanism families, and report localization only where the visible data identify it.

evaluations.feedback: Equal record budgets, multiplicity-adjusted alternatives and shared-batch failures make the firewall comparison credible. Sixty evaluations do not yet identify which contrasts are confirmed or how effect selection and endpoint-family multiplicity are handled. Those choices determine both error and power.
evaluations.revision: Preregister the selection rule, number of locked confirmations, multiplicity family and exact inflation estimand. Use identical generated records across competing policies and report conditional selected-effect bias alongside unconditional false-confirmation rates for each endpoint.

evaluations.feedback: Policy-episode units, overlapping source extracts and endpoint-specific truth directly address false contradictions. The one-column baseline may be intentionally handicapped unless its chosen estimand and available metadata are explicit. Closure must contribute to population employment rather than disappearing from the surviving-establishment sample.
evaluations.revision: Publish endpoint formulas and population-at-risk conventions, including closed establishments. Compare against a simple common-estimand table with equal metadata access; lock the 24 analyses and score mismatch detection separately from causal effect recovery.

evaluations.feedback: Smooth and true-break worlds permit useful measurement discrimination while retaining noncausal scope. A high-versus-low contrast tests an average difference, not a discontinuity; calling its significance a false threshold requires an explicit declaration rule. Change-point tuning must be nested within held-out folds.
evaluations.revision: Define a threshold claim separately from a bin contrast, calibrate all declaration rules on independent null seeds, and freeze nested tuning. Report false discontinuity claims in smooth worlds separately from legitimate average-association detection.

evaluations.feedback: Equal abstention options and deliberately similar observational worlds discourage causal overclaiming. Time-direction placebos can still pass under latent persistent confounding. Ninety panels split among three worlds do not define a distinct held-out-world distribution; country resampling may miss shared global shocks.
evaluations.revision: Specify structural-equation families and reserve new parameter regimes, feedback mixtures and shared-shock processes. Calibrate decisions on training worlds only; evaluate abstention on observationally equivalent worlds using panel-level and global-shock-aware uncertainty.

evaluations.feedback: The target separates policy values from causal estimates and correctly evaluates at episode level. A graph ledger cannot detect every latent shock from observed pretrends. The fixed reporting workflow, labeling rule and causal estimand under spillovers remain unspecified, so coverage could compare incompatible truths.
evaluations.revision: Define direct, total or exposed-population treatment effects under interference, publish all six fits and decision rules, and include indistinguishable confounded worlds. Score calibrated abstention without treating favorable pretrend tests as identification proof.

evaluations.feedback: Known workbook mutations and valid alternative weighting rules make a feasible reconstruction audit. A single checksum baseline with twenty checks needs an actual audit procedure, not just a reporting badge. Providing expected outputs may reveal some defects; clones share dependence through their parent workbooks.
evaluations.revision: Freeze auditor operations and equal information access, separate hidden scoring outputs from public specifications, and cluster mutations by source workbook. Include interacting defects and legitimate weighting variants; score numerical reconstruction separately from causal-scope statements.

evaluations.feedback: The tiered contract sharply distinguishes computation from changed-context inference, with appropriate family-level uncertainty. A binary baseline cannot natively produce the required four-way classification, making that metric structurally favor tiering. Twelve episode families and only single-defect examples may overstate generalization.
evaluations.revision: Give both workflows an identical four-way output field while varying only provenance organization. Reserve unseen episode generators and mixed measurement/code defects; report family-level uncertainty and category abstention when a change cannot be decomposed.

evaluations.feedback: The explicit weaker performance under latent selection is scientifically honest. However, contribution bounds need stated support and missingness assumptions to cover the full-panel association. The final-sample comparator receives the same metadata but lacks a defined use of its twelve recomputations.
evaluations.revision: Specify bounded outcome support, positivity and observed-history selection assumptions; keep no-assumption bounds visible. Freeze both twelve-operation workflows, evaluate newly generated histories, and score unresolved latent-selection cases separately from detectable observed-selection reversals.

evaluations.feedback: Matched nine-analysis budgets and episode holdouts give a practical reporting audit with appropriate closure cautions. Frame selection and heterogeneous effects can jointly generate the same matrix; attribution is not always identifiable. A pooled workflow also needs equal opportunity to preserve disagreement.
evaluations.revision: Define frame-specific versus population estimands and an unresolved-mixture label. Publish structural generators and both reporting algorithms, add observationally equivalent mixtures, and evaluate attribution calibration without rewarding mandatory matrix labels over equally informative narrative output.

evaluations.feedback: The four formulas, overhead policy, paired timing and explicit nonfinite outcomes turn the denominator argument into a discriminating audit. Accuracy remains visible rather than hidden inside efficiency. Repetition accounting should distinguish repeated measurements of fixed outputs from genuinely stochastic answer variation.
evaluations.revision: Lock whether timing repeats regenerate answers or replay fixed workloads, and assign output randomness its own level if needed. Publish family counts, amortization batch sizes and the preregistered paired rank-contrast calculation before measurement.

evaluations.feedback: The exact affected-minus-companion estimand, sham condition, separate original accuracy and sealed solver keys distinguish targeted updating from disruption. Pilot thresholds are locked before confirmation. The minimum meaningful contrast remains a design choice, so modest effects should not be transformed into evidence of no updating.
evaluations.revision: Report the continuous contrast and all component rates alongside threshold verdicts. Prespecify simultaneous uncertainty for updating and companion stability, and retain the inadequate-precision verdict without adaptively expanding confirmation after inspecting outcomes.

evaluations.feedback: This now tests template robustness rather than claiming the passport caused improvement. Latent-problem blocks, separate runtime checks and simultaneous equivalence margins align units with conclusions. Three templates only support local robustness, which the stated boundaries preserve; symbolic equivalence still needs a locked validation rule.
evaluations.revision: Specify the simultaneous interval construction and rejection criteria for template validation. Retain all latent-problem seed blocks, publish runtime repeatability separately, and label inference conditional on the three prespecified templates and frozen model.

evaluations.feedback: Random selection, family-only selection and within-family contamination can now distinguish when weighting helps rather than guarantee its success. The finite reference target and conditional resampling boundaries are explicit. Bootstrap uncertainty over reference instances represents a further sampling interpretation, not uncertainty in an already fixed reference mean.
evaluations.revision: Separate descriptive error against the fixed reference mean from inferential error for a generator-defined population. Freeze ease predictors and missing-support rules, and report transport-generator results separately without pooling them into reference-population performance.

evaluations.feedback: Global participant overlap, component clustering and conditional graph envelopes repair the principal dependence problem. However, partial-overlap report summaries do not necessarily reveal base-sample summaries or participant outcomes. The estimator must operate only on released summaries, rather than reconstructing latent independent samples from generator knowledge.
evaluations.revision: Define the observable report-level estimand and its aggregation weights explicitly; distinguish exact report duplication from overlapping participants. Publish graph-generation rules and component bootstrap computation without accessing hidden sample-level outcomes, and retain minimum-component abstention.

evaluations.feedback: Strong randomized-trial baselines, frozen equations and hidden case labels make the total-effect comparison honest. A mechanical repeat of the six-fit recipe for outcome M would include M as its own predictor, creating a degenerate model. Distinct equations also need endpoint-specific truth formulas in the collider case.
evaluations.revision: Prohibit adjustment for the outcome itself and list valid fits separately for H and M. Define subjective versus hormone truth for each structural case, including the collider replacement, and keep wrong-metadata interpretation failures separate from estimation error.

evaluations.feedback: Independent instrument assignment and relative-component estimands remove the earlier paired-recoding ambiguity. Strong harmonization and unresolved baselines keep the comparison fair. Eight training sites provide fragile slope and bootstrap inference; the measurement budget is clear, but hierarchical fit failures and confounded-allocation instrument balance need operational handling.
evaluations.revision: Freeze instrument assignment counts in the confounded allocation, the exact hierarchical likelihood and singular-fit policy. Assess bootstrap coverage over seeds before treating intervals as calibrated; count fit failure as unresolved and retain its cost.

evaluations.feedback: Locked top-three selection, exact tests, matched records and the secondary equal-estimator-size comparison distinguish selection from precision tradeoffs. The shared-batch stress case can invalidate apparent confirmation rather than being excluded. A full-data Holm win remains admissible, so added procedural complexity is not automatically rewarded.
evaluations.revision: Define whether full-data true-signal recovery includes all Holm discoveries or only the displayed three, and report both if relevant. Publish within-campaign contrast covariance and Monte Carlo intervals for campaign-wise error and conditional bias.

evaluations.feedback: Explicit endpoint formulas, closure conventions, competent table baseline and common output classes make this a fair compatibility audit. Regime-level inference respects shared shocks. The remaining implementation question is how manual compatibility checks become a repeatable comparator without adding unmeasured human time or hidden judgment.
evaluations.revision: Freeze deterministic pseudocode for both compatibility procedures, or define and budget human annotation separately. Publish the exact pair list and repeated-regime coverage design; distinguish numeric alignment failures from disagreement caused by source measurement error.

evaluations.feedback: Exact observational equivalence, common abstention losses and retained-family decisions prevent hidden simulator labels from masquerading as causal identification. Still, the four fitting methods and ten-operation menus are promised rather than specified. Latent-family rejection may depend strongly on arbitrary parameter restrictions and diagnostics.
evaluations.revision: Publish the exact fitted likelihoods, admissible parameter ranges, diagnostic menus and training-threshold algorithm before holdout. Define equivalence fixtures within that same candidate library, and count library misspecification separately from wrong causal-direction declarations.

evaluations.feedback: Hidden scoring references, interacting mutations and parent-level evaluation substantially improve the audit. Both reports now receive identical executed checks, so layering cannot improve which checks discover a defect; any gain must arise from extraction or reporting. Numerical improvement should not be presumed from layout alone.
evaluations.revision: Define how each frozen renderer maps the same check results into reported defect sets and values. Predeclare numerical equality as an expected control where computations are identical, and reserve the primary contrast for reporting omissions and scope errors.

evaluations.feedback: The complete narrative comparator and indistinguishable latent worlds repair forced attribution. Observable sensitivity is correctly separated from causal explanation. Joint frame-contrast intervals remain incompletely specified, especially with nonresponse and fixed-cohort estimands; simulator labels must score failure without serving as instructions to the reporting workflow.
evaluations.revision: Specify the frame-contrast estimator, missing-outcome policy and max-t resampling units. Release only observations, masks and declared assumptions to both renderers; reserve latent-world identity for scoring and require population abstention whenever released information cannot identify it.
